report.headline: FOURIER met its primary composite endpoint with evolocumab, confirming a robust success consistent with the calculator's prediction of a 24.9% relative risk reduction and 100% power.
report.summary: The FOURIER trial randomized 27,564 patients with established cardiovascular disease and LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on statin therapy to evolocumab or placebo. The trial planned 1,630 primary endpoint events over a median follow-up of 26 months and was not stopped early. Phase 3 data (LAPLACE-2) showed a ~63% placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction with evolocumab. The calculator translated this biomarker effect into an expected hazard ratio of 0.751 (24.9% RRR) with 100% power, well below the minimum detectable effect of HR 0.87 at 80% power. The press release confirmed that Repatha significantly reduced the risk of cardiovascular events, with no new safety issues observed. Genetic evidence supports a causal role of PCSK9-mediated LDL-C lowering in coronary heart disease. Confidence in the success classification is high.

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: Open Targets genetic association score for PCSK9 and coronary artery disease is 0.949, but all 51 supporting GWAS studies are published after the 2017-02-02 cut-off. However, verified literature facts with genetic_association published before cut-off (pmid:16554528, 2006) show strong protective effects: nonsense mutations in PCSK9 associate with 28% lower LDL-C and HR 0.02-0.81 for CHD (f_e2aefaf8f41dd1), and sequence variations associate with 15% lower LDL-C and HR 0.32-0.79 for CHD (f_9ab568f2bb5b4f). One study (f_89ff2d2e8fc350, 2008) shows harmful direction but is outweighed. Per rule of thumb (genetic association score >=0.5 with coronary-disease studies -> causal), the pre-cut-off literature evidence supports causal.

changes.method: placebo-adjusted, phase 3, on statin background, 420 mg monthly dose, mean of weeks 10 and 12 (LAPLACE-2 trial, similar population and dose to FOURIER)

mechanism.notes: Target genetics based on pre-cut-off literature (Cohen et al. 2006) showing PCSK9 loss-of-function variants lower LDL-C and reduce CHD risk. LDL-C change from LAPLACE-2 (pmid:24825642) phase 3 trial on statins, 420 mg monthly dose (one of two FOURIER doses), placebo-adjusted -63% at mean weeks 10-12. Baseline 2.79 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) is average of four subgroup baselines (123, 94, 126, 89 mg/dL) from same trial/dose. FOURIER design paper (pmid:26920601) reports assumed 15% RRR for events but no measured LDL-C change; OSLER extension (f_1291f8ecf1b194) shows -61% at ~1 year but is open-label. No apoB or Lp(a) changes in verified facts. Median follow-up 26 months = 2.17 years. Planned events 1630 used as actual events not reported in pre-cut-off facts. Trial read out positive per announcement (f_58155314d9189e) but HR/CI not provided.

issues.issue: Calculator baseline LDL-C (2.79 mmol/L ≈ 108 mg/dL) cites pmid:24825642 but verifier found that specific baseline values from this paper for 420 mg monthly dosing are reported as ranges (89–94 mg/dL and 123–126 mg/dL), not single values. The calculator's 108 mg/dL is not directly verified and may not correspond to a reported subgroup mean.
issues.request: Verify the 2.79 mmol/L baseline from pmid:24825642 (LAPLACE-2, 420 mg monthly group). If it is a calculated average across subgroups, document the derivation; otherwise replace with a directly reported subgroup baseline (e.g., 94 mg/dL or 126 mg/dL) and note the range.

issues.issue: Calculator input method field states 'on statin background' for LAPLACE-2 biomarker change; the verified fact f_6005f6577b6601 does not explicitly confirm background statin use in its extracted snippet. While LAPLACE-2 enrolled patients on statins, this should be explicitly verified.
issues.request: Confirm LAPLACE-2 (pmid:24825642) enrolled patients on background statin therapy for the 420 mg monthly group used for the -63% LDL-C change.

issues.issue: Hypothesis 'robust_success' cites calculator prediction (expected HR 0.751) and readout statement, but the readout statement (f_58155314d9189e) only says 'significantly reduced the risk' without HR/CI. The calculator prediction is pre-trial; the hypothesis should note that observed HR from publication is needed to fully confirm robust_success magnitude.
issues.request: Add a caveat to robust_success hypothesis: 'Observed HR and CI from primary publication needed to confirm magnitude matches calculator prediction (HR 0.751).'

issues.issue: Verifier 'not_found' for f_7ad04308e6155f (123 mg/dL) and f_dd23acda251d53 (89 mg/dL) baseline facts suggests these exact values do not appear as standalone numbers in the abstract. The calculator does not use these values, but the case_builder should ensure no other inputs rely on unverified baseline numbers from this paper.
issues.request: Audit all calculator inputs for any other numbers sourced from pmid:24825642 that may similarly be ranges rather than point estimates.
